title: VOA 核心词汇
subtitle: 源自 VOA Learning English 官方 Word Book（美国国际媒体署），约 1500 核心词

defsEn: one
any
each
zh: 第一个字母 A; 一个; 第一的

defsEn: having the power to do something
zh: a. 能干的, 能够的
examples: Would you be able to help me do that?
Would you be able to do that for us?

defsEn: almost (“about half”)
of or having a relation to (“We talk about the weather.”)
zh: prep. 在...周围, 大约, 有关, 关于
adv. 大约, 四处, 在附近, 周围
examples: He told me about his wife and her sister.
He told me about the change in the plan.

defsEn: at a higher place
zh: prep. 在上方, 超出
adv. 在上面
a. 上述的, 上面的
examples: Above all, try to be kind to the old.
Above all, I want to see him again.

defsEn: bad treatment causing harm or injury
zh: n. 滥用, 虐待, 恶习, 辱骂
vt. 滥用, 辱骂, 虐待
examples: Abuse of power is only possible because we let people have power.
The abuse of alcohol among young people is a serious problem.

defsEn: to agree to receive
zh: vt. 接受, 承认, 同意, 相信, 赞成, 承担, 承兑, 采纳, 接纳, 容忍
vi. 同意
examples: I would accept be it small, be it big.
I accept your challenge, time, and place of meeting.

defsEn: something that happens by chance or mistake
an unplanned event
zh: n. 意外事件, 机遇, 事故, 次要方面
examples: An accident may happen at any time.
The accident almost cost him his life.

defsEn: to say a person is responsible for an act or crime
to make a statement against someone
zh: vt. 指责, 控告, 归咎于
vi. 指责, 控告
examples: How dare you accuse me of that!
They accused him of being in the classroom in order to cause trouble.

defsEn: from side to side
to the other side
zh: prep. 越过, 穿过, 与...相交叉, 在...的对面
adv. 交叉, 到另一边, 在对面, 成十字
examples: He struck him across the face with the full weight of his hand.
I ran across his telephone number in an old address book of mine.

defsEn: to do something
zh: n. 行动, 行为, 幕, 法案
vi. 行动, 表演, 假装, 见效, 表现, 担当
vt. 扮演, 装作
examples: If you act normally, then people accept you.
And who would not act the same way?

defsEn: one who seeks change through action
zh: n. 激进主义分子
examples: He's an activist in his community.
She's an activist in her community.

defsEn: someone acting in a play or show
zh: n. 男演员, 行动者
examples: The actors must use the special entrance behind the theater.
The actor left the shooting location in a hurry.

defsEn: to put (something) with another to make it larger
to say more
zh: vt. 增加, 添加, 附带说明, 计算...总和
vi. 做加法, 积累而成, 增添
examples: Add a small amount of cream to the mixture.
Could you add the cost to my room bill?

defsEn: the executive part of a government, usually headed by a president or prime minister
zh: n. 行政, 管理, 政府机关
examples: They sent us to the administration office of the factory.
The administration decided to move the home office of the company to Hawaii.

defsEn: to accept (“admitted to the United Nations”)
to express one’s guilt or responsibility (“He admitted that what he did was wrong.”)
zh: vt. 承认, 接受, 允许进入, 容许
vi. 开向, 容许, 承认
examples: She would not admit him into her apartment.
I admit that you told me the truth.

defsEn: a grown person
zh: n. 成人, 成虫
a. 成年的, 成熟的
examples: I'm not an adult. I just look like one.
You're an adult, but you behave like a child.

defsEn: to show or present the qualities of a product to increase sales
zh: vt. 做广告, 通知, 公布
vi. 做广告
examples: Tom said that he would advertise his car in the paper next week.
I advertised my house in the newspaper.

defsEn: to help with information, knowledge or ideas in making a decision
zh: vt. 劝告, 给...出主意, 通知, 建议
vi. 提意见, 商量
examples: I advise you all to get plenty of rest.
I advise you not to walk home after dark.

defsEn: to produce an effect on
to influence (“A lack of sleep affected the singer’s performance.”)
zh: vt. 影响, 感动, 假装, 模仿, 爱好, 倾向于
n. 自觉感情
examples: It affects us to a great extent.
This affects every aspect of daily life.

defsEn: feeling fear
zh: a. 害怕的, 恐怕的, 遗憾的
examples: Why would I be afraid of you?
I'm afraid we must go if we want to get home before dark.

defsEn: later
behind
zh: prep. 在...之后, 由于
conj. 在...之后
adv. 后来
examples: After dinner, I take a walk on the beach.
After all, you do want to sell the property.

defsEn: another time
as before
zh: adv. 再一次, 又, 到原处

defsEn: opposed to
not agreeing with something
zh: prep. 反对, 对着, 倚靠
examples: It's against my nature to break a commitment.
He held me against the wall by the neck.

defsEn: how old a person or thing is
zh: n. 年龄, 老年, 成年, 寿命, 时代, 时期
v. 变老, 成熟
examples: What age do you want to live to?
Up to what age do you want to live to?

defsEn: an organization that is part of a larger group (“an agency of the United Nations”)
zh: n. 代理机构, 经销商, 中介
examples: The agency is the size of a city.
The ad agency has a lot riding on this account.

defsEn: an attack against a person or country
the violation of a country’s borders
zh: n. 侵犯, 侵略
examples: Aggression is a sign of fear.
Is aggression natural, or is it learned?

defsEn: of time past
before now
zh: adv. 以前
examples: I wrote to you a fortnight ago. Could you get round to replying, please?
Sami met Layla two Halloweens ago.

defsEn: to have the same belief as someone
to be willing to do something
zh: vi. 同意, 赞成, 应允, 适合
vt. 承认, 认定, 同意
examples: I agree that we need to fix this today.
I agree with them that we should try again.

defsEn: farming
zh: n. 农业
examples: Agriculture and industry are limited due to the small size of the island.
In Algeria, agriculture remains a big employer.

defsEn: to help
to support
n. help, assistance
zh: n. 帮助, 外援, 助手
vt. 援助, 帮助, 有助于
vi. 帮助
examples: They came to our aid at once.
And what's that in aid of?

defsEn: to point a gun at
n. a goal or purpose
zh: n. 目标, 瞄准, 击中目标的能力
vi. 对准目标, 致力, 打算
vt. 瞄准
应用接口模块, 医学人工智能, 相联索引法, 异步接口模块
自动化信息管理, 自动化综合制造, 自动化库存管理
examples: We aim to complete the project by next spring.
I aim to be a doctor when I grow up.

defsEn: the mixture of gases around the earth, mostly nitrogen and oxygen, that we breathe
zh: n. 空气, 旋律, 态度
vt. 晾, 使通风, 夸耀
examples: Air pollution will be a threat to our survival.
The Air Diet: Why Eat When You Can Pretend!

defsEn: a vehicle with wings that flies airplane
zh: n. 飞机
examples: The airplane accident took place yesterday, a long way off at sea.
I took an airplane for the first time in my life.

defsEn: a place where airplanes take off and land
zh: n. 飞机场
examples: Which airport do I leave from?
I went to the airport to see my mother off.

defsEn: a collection of recorded music
zh: n. 粘贴簿, 唱片套
examples: What album do you want to listen to?
This album is not afraid to go against the grain of traditional music practice.

defsEn: a strong, colorless liquid, usually made from grain, used in drinks or in industrial products
zh: n. 酒精, 酒
examples: You drank alcohol again? I told you not to!
The alcohol cooks off when you boil it.

defsEn: having life
not dead
zh: a. 活着的, 活泼的, 敏感的, 热闹的
examples: Alive or dead, I'll always love you.
If Sami is alive, we want to bring him home.

defsEn: everything
everyone
the complete amount
zh: a. 所有的, 全部的, 一切的
adv. 全部, 全然
pron. 全部
n. 全部
examples: We all have our work cut out for us.
All the people in this room know each other.

defsEn: a nation or person joined with another for a special purpose
zh: n. 同盟者, 同盟国, 助手
vt. 使联盟, 使联合, 使有关系
vi. 结盟
examples: Are you an ally or an enemy?
I am an ally of the weak.

defsEn: a little less than completely
zh: adv. 几乎, 差不多
examples: I almost have enough time to do that today.
We almost always speak to each other in French.

defsEn: separated from others
zh: a. 孤独的, 单独的, 独自的
adv. 独自地
examples: Alone we fall, but together we win.
He, and he alone, must go.

defsEn: near or on (“along the road”)
zh: adv. 平行地, 向前
prep. 沿着
examples: Along the way will be fine. It's a complicated matter.
He strode along the road in a great hurry.

defsEn: before now
even now
zh: adv. 已经, 早已
examples: I already know you want to quit your job.
You already seem to know how to do that.

defsEn: added to
too
zh: adv. 也, 并且, 同样地
examples: You could also help me fill out this form.
I also know a thing or two about cooking.

defsEn: even if it is true that
zh: conj. 虽然, 尽管
examples: Although he says it, she will do it.
Although you love another, I love you.

defsEn: at all times
every time
zh: adv. 总是, 始终
examples: I always tell the truth. Even when I lie.
I always try to find some time to read.

defsEn: a nation’s highest diplomatic representative (to another government)
zh: n. 大使
examples: The ambassador will be recalled from his present post soon.
The ambassador greeted congress on behalf of his government.

defsEn: to add to or to change. (a proposal or law)
zh: vt. 修改, 改善, 改良
vi. 改过自新
examples: He amended his way of living.
Tom made amends to Mary by taking her out to dinner.

defsEn: the bullets or shells fired from guns
zh: n. 军火, 弹药
examples: This ammunition is much more effective.
Gustavo drove to the ammunition shop.

defsEn: in or part of (a group)
zh: prep. 在...之中
examples: Among people my age, I'm the only one without a phone.
Who among us does not like to be famous?

defsEn: the number, size or weight of anything
zh: n. 总数, 总额
vi. 总计, 等同
examples: No amount of training can prepare you for this.
The amount of water in the planet remains constant.

defsEn: a lack of order
lawlessness
zh: n. 无政府状态, 政治混乱
examples: Anarchy is the mother of order.
Anarchy isn't a lack of rules; it's a lack of rulers.

defsEn: a family member from the past
zh: n. 祖先, 祖宗
examples: Our ancestors developed massive jaws as a result of constant combat.
This is how the ancestors left it.

defsEn: very old
long ago
zh: a. 古代的, 古老的, 年老的, 旧的
examples: The ancient and the modern, the past and the future are all one.
It's an ancient language that no one can read.

defsEn: also
in addition to
with
zh: conj. 和, 与

defsEn: a strong emotion against someone or something
zh: n. 忿怒
vt. 激怒, 使发怒
vi. 发怒
examples: They anger us with their behavior.
He said it out of anger.

defsEn: a living creature that moves, such as a dog or cat
zh: n. 动物
examples: An animal can be a character in a novel.
Which animal would you compare me to?

defsEn: a yearly celebration or observance of an event that happened in the past
zh: n. 周年纪念
examples: It's the anniversary of the end of the war.
He forgot the anniversary of their first date.

defsEn: to make known publicly
to declare officially
zh: vt. 宣布, 声称, 显示, 预告
vi. 当报幕员, 宣布参加竞选
examples: He announced that he would come at once and investigate the matter.
They announced the date of their wedding in the newspaper.

defsEn: one more
a different one
zh: a. 另外的, 再一的, 不同的
pron. 又一个, 另一个, 类似的另一个
examples: Another half hour, and our master will be back here.
Another bus will be here soon.

defsEn: a statement produced by a question
v. to make a statement after being asked a question
zh: n. 答案, 回答, 回报, 答辩
vt. 回答, 反驳, 适应, 响应, 符合
vi. 回答, 答应, 负责, 符合, 成功
examples: The answer to that would be no.
I answer to no one and I do what I want.

defsEn: special proteins produced in the blood that kill harmful bacteria
zh: n. 抗体（antibody的复数）
examples: Antibodies give a new lease of life.
Antibodies are a key part of the immune system.

defsEn: one or more of no special kind
zh: a. 任何的
pron. 任何
examples: Any student in our college can use the computer.
Any paper you read will tell the same story.

defsEn: to express regret for a mistake or accident for which one accepts responsibility
zh: vi. 道歉, 辩解
examples: I apologize in front of all of you.
I apologize for not writing to you before.

defsEn: to take to a higher court, person or group for a decision
to call on somebody for help
zh: n. 恳求, 诉请, 上诉, 吸引力
vi. 呼吁, 诉请, 要求, 上诉, 有吸引力
vt. 将...上诉
examples: I appeal to you to contribute to the new clinic.
I appeal to him for his advice.

defsEn: to show oneself
to come into sight
to seem
zh: vi. 出现, 显得, 来到
examples: You appear a little old for this job.
You appear to be critical of all people.

defsEn: to name
to choose. (“appoint a judge”)
zh: vt. 任命, 指定, 下令
examples: Appoint me as the project manager.
Appoint me as the project lead.

defsEn: to agree with
to agree to support
zh: vt. 赞同, 核准, 为...提供证据
vi. 赞许
examples: I approve of this statement of his.
They would not approve my loan.

defsEn: the scientific study of past human life and activities
zh: 考古学
examples: Archeology is the science that studies the remnants of human civilization.
Archeology reveals the secrets of the past.

defsEn: any place or part of it
zh: n. 区域, 面积, 范围, 空地
examples: The area looked like the perfect spot for a horror film.
In this area, all of us only drink bottled water.

defsEn: to offer reasons for or against something
to dispute
to disagree
zh: vi. 提出理由, 争论, 辩论
vt. 主张, 辩论, 证明, 说服
examples: We argued with each other about the best place for a holiday.
They argue that the distribution of wealth should be equitable.

defsEn: military equipment
weapons
zh: n. 武器, 军事行动
examples: When I'm in his arms, I feel good.
He held her in his arms all night long.

defsEn: military ground forces
zh: n. 军队, 陆军
examples: The army advanced during the night.
The army advanced up the hill.

defsEn: on every side (of)
zh: prep. 包围, 在...周围, 四处
adv. 兜着圈子, 在附近, 到处
examples: Around here, you have to make your own fun.
I'll be up and around before you know it.

defsEn: to seize a person for legal action
to take as a prisoner
zh: n. 逮捕, 监禁
vt. 拘捕, 抑制, 吸引, 阻止
examples: Arrest that man and lock him away.
They arrested the black guy and let the white guy go.

defsEn: to come to a place, especially at the end of a trip
zh: vi. 到达, 抵达
examples: I arrive at your house in one hour.
When I arrive at the station, I will call you.

defsEn: expressions or creations by humans, such as paintings, music, writing or statues art
zh: n. 艺术, 人文科学, 技术, 巧妙, 诡计, 美术
examples: Art imitates life much more often than the other way around.
The art museum is across the street from the bank.

defsEn: big guns
zh: n. 火炮, 炮兵, 炮术
examples: The artillery is placed in a clearing.
The cavaliers were decimated by the artillery.

defsEn: equally (“as fast as”)
when
while
zh: adv. 同样地, 例如
prep. 做为, 当作
conj. 当...之时, 以...的方式, 像...一样, 因为

defsEn: the part left after something burns
zh: n. 灰, 灰烬
examples: He shook the ash from the cigarette out of the car.
The volcanic ash brought air traffic to a halt.

defsEn: to question
to say something is wanted (“We ask the teacher questions every day.”)
zh: vi. 问, 要求
vt. 问, 要求, 邀请, 需要
examples: I asked you not to get angry with me.
I asked him not to get angry with me.

defsEn: to help
zh: n. 帮助, 协助
vt. 帮助, 促进
vi. 协助, 参加
examples: If you could assist me, it would be a great help.
We'll assist you in any way we can.

defsEn: a person who travels in space
zh: n. 太空旅行者, 宇航员
examples: The astronaut found an intelligent organism.
An astronaut can float in space.

defsEn: the scientific study of stars and the universe astronaut
zh: n. 天文学
examples: Astronomy is at the same time the most ancient and the most modern science.
I got into astronomy because of my partner.

defsEn: political protection given by a government to a person from another country
zh: n. 庇护, 收容所
examples: They built an asylum for the blind.
The asylum seeker was finally able to speak to a lawyer.

defsEn: in or near (“at the edge”)
where (“look at”)
when (“at noon”)
zh: prep. 在, 向, 对

defsEn: the gases surrounding any star or planet
zh: n. 大气, 空气, 气氛
examples: The atmosphere is much better today than yesterday.
In the stifling atmosphere, I can barely breath.

defsEn: a very small part of all things
the smallest part of an element that can join with parts of other elements
zh: n. 原子, 核能, 微粒, 微量
examples: The atom bomb is an awful weapon.
An ion is an atom or molecule with a net electric charge.

defsEn: to tie together
to connect
zh: vt. 附上, 使依附, 使附属, 使喜爱, 系, 缚
vi. 附属, 归属, 联系在一起
examples: Attach a recent photograph to your application form.
Attach this label to your package.

defsEn: a violent attempt to damage, injure or kill
v. to start a fight
zh: n. 攻击, 抨击
vt. 攻击, 抨击, 动手干
vi. 攻击
examples: The attack might instead produce the opposite effect.
We could be under attack at any time.

defsEn: to work toward something
to try
to make an effort
zh: n. 尝试, 企图
vt. 尝试, 企图
examples: What would you attempt to do if you knew you could not fail?
He attempted to jump-start my truck with his car.

defsEn: to be present at
zh: vt. 参加, 照料, 伴随
vi. 专心于, 照顾, 服侍, 出席
examples: He could not attend the party because of illness.
I could not attend the meeting.

defsEn: close or careful observing of, or listening to, someone or something (“The student paid attention to his teacher.”)
zh: n. 注意, 注意力
examples: He paid no attention to what she said.
Attention: Chilean Spanish may sound strange elsewhere.

defsEn: a vehicle with wheels used to carry people
a car
zh: n. 汽车
examples: The automobile is of great use in our life.
Automobile sales suffered a setback at the end of the financial year.

defsEn: the time of the year between summer and winter
zh: n. 秋天, 成熟期
examples: In autumn, some animals store food away for the winter.
In autumn all the leaves on the mountain change color.

defsEn: present and ready for use
willing to serve or help. (“There was a list of available candidates.”)
zh: a. 可利用的, 可获得的, 有效的
examples: I'm available now, but I have an appointment in one hour.
Are you available next week for a follow-up interview?

defsEn: something (a number) representing the middle
ad. common
normal
zh: n. 平均, 平均数, 一般水平, 海损
a. 平均的, 中等的, 平常的
vt. 算出...平均数, 平均做, 均分, 使平衡
vi. 平均为, 呈中间色
examples: On average, how many cups of coffee do you drink every day?
On average, how many cups of coffee do you drink a day?

defsEn: to stay away from
zh: vt. 避免, 防止, 撤消
examples: I avoid the sun to preserve my youth.
I avoid driving at night if I can.

defsEn: not sleeping
zh: a. 醒着的
vt. 唤醒, 唤起, 使意识到
vi. 醒来, 被唤起, 意识到
examples: Are you awake enough to do this?
Are you awake for a particular reason?

defsEn: an honor or prize for an act or service
zh: n. 奖品, 裁定, 判决
vt. 授予, 给予
examples: The award should be for me!
They awarded her first prize at the flower show.

defsEn: not near
zh: adv. 离去
examples: I could be away for some time.
To be away from you would be a heavy price for my freedom.

defsEn: a newly born creature
zh: n. 婴孩
examples: The baby will be able to walk soon.
Baby you can make my day.

defsEn: the part behind the front
ad. the other way from forward
zh: a. 后面的
vt. 使后退, 支持
vi. 倒退, 背靠
adv. 向后地
n. 背部, 后面
examples: Back away from the window and come to me.
He said that he would be back right away.

defsEn: living things that are one cell and can be seen only through a microscope
some cause disease
zh: pl. 细菌
examples: Bacteria, like cyanobacteria, consist of only one cell.
Bacteria are the only culture some people have.

defsEn: wrong
acting against the law
not good
zh: a. 坏的
n. 坏
adv. 坏地
examples: It would be a bad mistake to do that.
It would be a bad idea to go up there.

defsEn: to make two sides or forces equal
zh: n. 平衡, 差额
vi. 平衡, 相等
vt. 称, 权衡, 比较, 使平衡, 结算, 抵消
examples: The balance of public opinion remains in his favor.
A balance can be positive or negative.

defsEn: something round ball
zh: n. 球, 舞会, 球状物
v. 捏成球形
examples: The ball hit the back of the net.
The ball hit him on the left side of the head.

defsEn: a device of strong, light material that rises when filled with gas lighter than air
zh: n. 气球
vt. 使成气球状
vi. 膨胀如气球, 激增
examples: The balloon burst with a loud noise.
The balloon flew and burst in the sky.

defsEn: a piece of paper used for voting
zh: n. 投票, 投票用纸, 抽签
vi. 投票, 抽签
vt. 投票选出, 拉选票
examples: The ballot paper must be put into an envelope.

defsEn: to not permit
to stop
n. an official restriction
zh: n. 禁令
vt. 禁止, 取缔
examples: The band came at the head of the parade.
A band led the parade through the city.

defsEn: an organization that keeps and lends money
zh: n. 银行, 堤, 岸
examples: In which bank do you have an account?
I bank on him to solve the matter.

defsEn: to prevent or block

zh: n. 变化, 找回的零钱, 找头, 更换
vt. 改变, 更换, 兑换
examples: If you change your mind, please let me know.

defsEn: to accuse someone of something, usually a crime
n. a statement in which someone is accused of something

vi. 冲锋, 要价, 收费

defsEn: to run or go after someone or something

to steal from

v. 欺骗, 逃脱, 骗取

defsEn: to shout approval or praise

vt. 使振奋, 欢呼

Cheer him up when you see him.

defsEn: elements found in nature or made by people
substances used in the science of chemistry

defsEn: the scientific study of substances, what they are made of, how they act under different conditions, and how they form other substances
zh: n. 化学, 化学过程

If it's a chemistry, leave it to me!

ad. leading
most important

defsEn: a baby
a boy or girl

She told the child to eat up the food.

Children often cry just because they want some attention.

Your chromosome can undoubtedly show what kind of human you are!

defsEn: any important large town

In our city, the people elect the mayor.

defsEn: a large number of people gathered in one place
zh: n. 群众, 一伙人
vt. 拥挤, 挤满, 挤进
examples: The crowd should show a bit of respect.
There was a crowd of people at the entrance of the theater.

defsEn: to damage or destroy by great weight
to defeat completely
zh: n. 压碎, 粉碎, 群众, 迷恋
vt. 压破, 征服, 塞, 弄皱, 榨出
vi. 被压碎, 起皱, 挤
examples: My crush said "good night" to me last night.
Crush the can before you throw it away.

defsEn: to express or show sorrow or pain
zh: n. 叫声, 哭声, 大叫
vi. 哭, 叫, 喊
vt. 叫喊, 大声说, 哭出
examples: She could not but cry at the sad news.
I cry every time I watch this movie.

defsEn: all the beliefs, traditions and arts of a group or population
zh: n. 文化, 修养, 耕种
vt. 耕种, 培养
examples: Cultures of the East and the West meet together in this country.
Cultures have a coherent view of the world.

defsEn: to improve health
to make well (“The doctor can cure the disease.”)
n. something that makes a sick person well (“Antibiotics are a cure for infection.”)
zh: n. 治疗, 治愈, 治疗法
vt. 治疗, 治愈, 改正, 腌制, 加工处理, 使硫化
vi. 受治疗, 被加工处理, 被硫化
examples: There is no cure for the common cold.
I cured my cold with this medicine.

defsEn: an order to people to stay off the streets or to close their businesses
zh: n. 晚钟, 打晚钟时刻, 宵禁
examples: A curfew was imposed on the city.
There is a curfew in effect from dusk to dawn.

defsEn: movement of air, water or electricity
ad. belonging to the present time (“She found the report in a current publication.”)
zh: n. 涌流, 趋势, 流
a. 流通的, 现在的, 当前的, 流行的
examples: The current slump of the economy will not turn into a serious depression.
Your current thinking got you here. Only new thinking will get you out.

defsEn: a long-established belief or activity of a people
zh: n. 习惯, 风俗, 海关, 自定义
a. 定制的
examples: Customs vary from region to region.
It's my custom to go for a walk before breakfast.

defsEn: taxes on imports
zh: n. 海关, 关卡, 关税
examples: We should do away with out-of-date customs.
A customs official asked me to open my suitcase.

defsEn: to divide or injure with a sharp tool
to make less
to reduce
zh: n. 切口, 割伤, 降低, 切, 割, 砍, 削, 伤口, 削减, 缩短, 删节, 通路
a. 经切割的, 缩减的
vt. 切, 割, 减少, 刺痛, 开辟, 雕刻, 删节, 缩短, 停止, 排斥, 切断, 关, 显出
vi. 切, 割, 砍, 刺痛, 相交, 抄近路, 剪辑
examples: He cut the hunting trip short for that season.
He cut a poor figure after his long illness.

defsEn: a wall built across a river to hold back flowing water dam
zh: n. 水坝, 障碍
v. 控制, 筑坝
examples: This dam generates more power than any other dam in the world.
The dam burst owing to the heavy rain.

defsEn: to cause injury or destruction
n. harm
hurt or injury, usually to things
zh: n. 损害, 伤害
v. 损害
examples: The damage will cost us a lot of money.
The damage here is more severe than on the other side of town.

defsEn: to move the body and feet to music
n. a series of steps, usually to music
zh: n. 跳舞, 舞蹈, 舞会
v. 跳舞
examples: Dance as much as you want.
I dance, but not very well.

defsEn: a strong chance of suffering injury, damage or loss
zh: n. 危险, 威胁
examples: We're in danger of missing the train.
It could be that we're in danger.

defsEn: having little or no light (“The room was dark.”)
zh: n. 黑暗, 夜, 黄昏, 模糊
a. 黑暗的, 暗的, 深色的, 隐密的, 模糊的, 无知的
examples: It'll be dark by the time we get there.
On the dark street, I was a little bit afraid.

defsEn: an expression of time
a day, month and year
zh: n. 日期, 约会, 枣椰树
vt. 约会, 定日期
vi. 注明日期, 过时
examples: A date will soon be set for a hearing.
Her date should be here soon.

defsEn: a person’s female child
zh: n. 女儿
a. 女儿的
examples: My daughter will come of age this year.
My daughter will come of age next year.

defsEn: twenty–four hours
the hours of sunlight
zh: n. 天, 日子, 白天, 工作日
examples: In this day and age, you should be careful.
The day after tomorrow I have my job interview.

defsEn: not living
zh: a. 死的, 不活泼的, 麻木的, 熄灭的
n. 死者
adv. 完全地, 直接地
examples: A dead fox lay in the grass at the side of the road.
When I'm dead, no one will make me suffer.

defsEn: not able to hear
zh: a. 聋的
examples: Deaf people can talk in sign language.
Deaf people can converse in sign language.

defsEn: to have to do with (“The talks will deal with the problem of pollution.”)
to buy or sell (“Her company deals in plastic.”) n. an agreement
zh: n. 交易, 协定, 数量, 买卖, 松木板
vi. 处理, 应付, 做生意
vt. 分配, 发牌, 给予
examples: I deal with people like that all the time.
The deal should work out well for us.

defsEn: to argue for or against something
n. a public discussion or argument
zh: n. 辩论, 讨论
v. 争论, 辩论
examples: The debate will start in an hour.
In a debate, I try to be composed and correct.

defsEn: something that is owed
the condition of owing
zh: n. 债务, 罪过
examples: His debts amount to more than he can pay.
Her debts amount to more than she can pay.

defsEn: to choose
to settle
to judge
zh: v. 决定, 判决
examples: I could not decide which way to choose.
If I decide I have to sleep, then I sleep.

defsEn: to say
to make a statement
zh: v. 宣布, 声明, 申报, 断言
examples: Declare your position in a debate.
If I declare bankruptcy, will I be able to keep my house?

defsEn: to make less in size or amount
zh: n. 减少, 减少量
v. 减少
examples: He decreased the price for her.
The decrease in crime can be attributed to several factors.

defsEn: going far down
a long way from top to bottom
zh: a. 深的
adv. 深入地
n. 深渊, 深处
examples: Deep down, you know what you have to do.
Deep-sea fish often look ugly, but they taste good.

defsEn: to cause to lose in a battle or struggle
n. a loss
the condition of having lost
zh: n. 败北, 失败
vt. 击败, 使落空
examples: That would be to defeat the object.
The defeat was too hard on them.

defsEn: to guard or fight against attack
to protect
zh: vt. 防护, 辩护, 防卫
examples: To defend their land has now become a sin?
Jackals defend their territory as a team.

defsEn: a shortage that results when spending is greater than earnings, or imports are greater than exports
zh: n. 赤字, 不足额
examples: Eliminating the deficit will be a very difficult job.
He made up the deficit with a loan.

defsEn: to give the meaning of
to explain
zh: vt. 定义, 规定, 使明确
examples: Could you define the word and say what you understand by it?
How would you define a successful marriage?

defsEn: a measure of temperature
zh: n. 程度, 度数, 学位, 度
examples: To what degree can we trust him?
There's a degree of stress in every job.

defsEn: to decide to do something at a later time
to postpone
to cause to be late
zh: n. 耽搁, 迟滞
v. 耽搁, 延迟
examples: The delay forced us to spend the night in a very expensive hotel.
This'll delay my trip a long time.

defsEn: one sent to act for another
one who represents another
zh: n. 代表
vt. 委派...为代表
examples: We delegated him to negotiate with them.
They delegate tasks to their team.

defsEn: to ask by ordering
to ask with force
zh: n. 要求, 需求, 需要
v. 要求, 查询
examples: I demand that you give me back my money.
I demand that you give me my money back.

defsEn: the system of government in which citizens vote to choose leaders or to make other important decisions
zh: n. 民主政治, 民主主义
examples: Democracy is the government of the people, by the people, and for the people.
Democracy is the government of the people, by the people, for the people.

defsEn: to make a public show of opinions or feelings (“The crowd demonstrated in support of human rights.”)
to explain by using examples (“The teacher demonstrated the idea with an experiment.”)
zh: vt. 示范, 证明
vi. 示威
examples: Would you demonstrate the next problem at the board?
He went on to demonstrate how to use the machine.

defsEn: close together
thick
zh: a. 密集的, 浓厚的
examples: There is a dense population of young people around here.
The dense fog made the building invisible.

defsEn: to accuse of being wrong or evil
to criticize severely
zh: vt. 告发, 抨击, 谴责
examples: She denounced him to the police as a murderer.
He denounced the incompetence of this government.

defsEn: to declare that something is not true
to refuse a request
zh: v. 否认, 拒绝
examples: They deny that they left early.
He denies even the sun in the sky.

defsEn: to need help and support
zh: vi. 靠, 视...而定, 信赖
examples: We depend on the tourist industry.
Depending on where you sit, you might not be able to see the stage.

defsEn: to regret strongly
to express sadness
zh: vt. 悲悼, 哀叹, 对...深感遗憾
examples: We deplore your cruelty to animals.
He deplored the fact that Silesia was no longer Prussian.

defsEn: to move forces or weapons into positions for action
zh: v. 展开, 配置
examples: The US deployed its own troops to Iraq.
Hezbollah deployed its troops to Syria to defend Assad's regime.

defsEn: severe unhappiness
a period of reduced business and economic activity during which many people lose their jobs
zh: 俯角
examples: His depression came to an end when she kissed him.
Tom fell into depression from working too hard.

defsEn: to give a word picture of something
to give details of something
zh: vt. 描述, 描绘, 画
examples: How would you describe the people in your country?
Describe a tourist attraction you would like to visit.

defsEn: a dry area of land desert
zh: n. 沙漠, 应得的赏罚, 功劳
a. 沙漠的, 不毛的
vt. 放弃, 遗弃, 擅离
vi. 逃掉
examples: In the desert, water is worth its weight in gold.
That desert looks like the surface of the moon.

defsEn: to plan or create plans for
zh: n. 设计, 图样, 方案, 企图
v. 设计, 计划
examples: Could you design a new emotion?
A design shows the scene of a torture.

defsEn: to want very much
to wish for
zh: n. 欲望, 要求
vt. 想要, 请求
vi. 渴望
examples: They desire to remove a weight from the heart.
We desire to remove a weight from the heart.

defsEn: to break into pieces
to end the existence of
zh: vt. 破坏, 毁坏, 消灭
examples: You destroyed my life and now you expect me to forgive you.
He'll destroy all the evidence and Bond with it.

defsEn: a small part of something
a small piece of information
zh: n. 细节, 详情
vt. 详述, 选派
vi. 画详图
examples: A detailed report will be sent you by next mail.
He gave us a detailed account of the accident.

defsEn: to keep or hold (“The police detained several suspects for questioning.”)
zh: vt. 扣留, 扣押, 耽搁
examples: He was detained at the border for a passport check.
I got detained at the airport.

defsEn: to grow
to create
to experience progress
zh: vt. 发展, 使发达, 进步, 洗印, 显影
vi. 发展, 生长
examples: Develop a habit of regular exercise for physical health.
If you develop lesions in the area, I think you should see a doctor.

defsEn: a piece of equipment made for a special purpose
zh: n. 装置, 设计, 策略, 发明物, 设备
examples: This device will warn you when you leave your lane.
The device fits in the palm of your hand.

defsEn: a ruler with complete power
zh: n. 命令者, 独裁者
examples: The dictator rules the country with an iron grip.
The dictator forced the tribe to agree on the terms of surrender.

defsEn: to become dead
to stop living
to end
zh: vi. 死亡, 消逝, 平息, 熄灭, 漠然, 渴望
vt. 死
n. 骰子, 冲模
examples: When you die, you will begin to see more.
If I die today, I will be dead tomorrow.

defsEn: usual daily food and drink
zh: n. 日常饮食, 议会
vt. 照规定饮食
vi. 忌食
examples: She is on a diet for fear that she will put on weight.
I'll be on a diet from tomorrow.

defsEn: not the same
zh: a. 不同的
examples: Is this a different word or just another form of the same word?
He and I are different but we respect each other a lot.

defsEn: not easy
hard to do, make or carry out
zh: a. 困难的
examples: How difficult would it be to do that?
It would be difficult to do that now.

defsEn: to make a hole in the ground
zh: vt. 挖, 翻土, 发掘
vi. 挖掘
n. 挖掘
examples: I cannot dig a hole in the middle of the street.
Dig a hole here and put the gold pieces into it.

defsEn: the main amount of food eaten at a usual time (“The family had its dinner at noon.”)
a special event that includes food (“The official dinner took place at the White House.”)
zh: n. 晚餐, 正餐, 宴会
examples: Dinner will be ready when you arrive.
Our dinner should be ready soon.

defsEn: a person who represents his or her government in dealing with another government
zh: n. 外交官, 有外交手腕的人
examples: He is a diplomat at the American Embassy.
The diplomat was shot at the embassy.

defsEn: to lead
to aim or show the way (“He directed me to the theater.”)
ad. straight to something
not through some other person or thing (“The path is direct.”)
zh: a. 直接的, 坦白的
vt. 指示, 指挥, 命令, 导演
vi. 指导, 指挥
adv. 直接地
examples: Could you direct me to the bus stop?
Could you direct me to the station?

defsEn: the way (east, west, north, south)
where someone or something came dirt from or went to
zh: n. 方向, 指导, 趋势
examples: What direction should this project go in?
In which direction will Syria develop after the regime change?

defsEn: earth or soil
zh: n. 污垢, 泥土
examples: She swept the dirt from the porch.
He brushed the dirt off his jeans.

defsEn: to become unseen
to no longer exist
zh: vi. 消失, 不见
examples: I could disappear at any time.
We disappear together in the forest.

defsEn: to take away weapons
to no longer keep weapons
to make a bomb harmless by removing its exploding device
zh: vt. 解除武装, 裁军, 缓和
vi. 放下武器
examples: Ziri forgot to disarm his alarm.
With a disarming smile, Mary made her way through the waiting crowd.

defsEn: an event causing widespread destruction or loss of life, such as an earthquake or plane crash
zh: n. 灾祸, 不幸, 彻底失败
examples: It would be a disaster if they ever got a majority in the parliament.
Disaster was just a matter of time.

defsEn: to find or learn something
zh: vt. 发现, 找到, 暴露
vi. 发现
examples: Discover a way around the situation.
If they discover our secret, it will be the whole shooting match.

defsEn: unfair treatment or consideration based on opinions about a whole group instead of on the qualities of an individual. (“He was accused of discrimination against people from other countries.”)
zh: n. 差别, 岐视, 辨别力
examples: Discrimination made it difficult for me to rent an apartment.
Discrimination made it difficult for me to find a job.

defsEn: to talk about
to exchange ideas
zh: vt. 讨论, 论述
examples: They discuss the impact of technology.
They discuss the matter every day.

defsEn: a sickness in living things, often caused by viruses, germs or bacteria
zh: n. 疾病, 弊病
examples: The disease confined him to bed throughout winter.
The disease sheared him of his physical strength.

defsEn: to send away
to refuse to consider
zh: vt. 解散, 开除, 解职
vi. 解散
examples: We dismiss people for talking about themselves but it's the subject they treat best.
Vladimir dismissed the noise as the wind.

defsEn: to oppose strongly by argument
n. an angry debate
zh: n. 争论
v. 争论
examples: I disputed with him about world peace for an hour.
We disputed the victory to the end.

defsEn: a person who strongly disagrees with his or her government
zh: a. 意见不同的, 持不同政见的
n. 意见不同的人, 持不同政见者
examples: The political dissident has spent nearly a decade under house arrest.
All political dissidents were purged under the former regime.

defsEn: the amount of space between two places or objects (“The distance from my house to your house is two kilometers.”)
zh: n. 距离, 远方, 遥远
examples: There is no distance on this earth as far away as yesterday.
The distance between the object and the text is too large.

defsEn: to jump into water head first
zh: n. 潜水, 跳水
vi. 跳水, 俯冲, 猛冲
vt. 把...突然伸入
examples: I made a dive for his knife.
He dived head first into the water.

defsEn: to separate into two or more parts
zh: vi. 分开, 分配, 分裂
vt. 分, 分开, 分裂, 除
n. 分配, 分水岭
examples: Divide it into two equal parts.
We divided the money between us.

defsEn: to act
to make an effort
zh: v. 做, 进行, 完成
examples: Do you have to go to the post office?
What do you say we go watch a movie?

defsEn: a person trained in medicine to treat sick people
zh: n. 医生, 博士
vt. 授以博士学位, 诊断, 修改
vi. 行医
examples: Her doctor told her to cut down on drinking.
The doctor says that she will see you now.

defsEn: an official piece of paper with facts written on it, used as proof or support of something
zh: n. 文件, 公文, 文档
vt. 证明, 为...引证
examples: The document could destroy the authority of the modern church.
This document outlined the structure and purpose of the organization.

defsEn: a small animal that often lives with humans
zh: n. 狗, 坏蛋
vt. 跟踪, 尾随
examples: My dog and I sleep in the same room.
Our dog and cat get on well with each other.

defsEn: United States money, one hundred cents dollar
zh: n. 美元, 元(加、澳等国货币单位)
examples: The US dollar has hit an all-time low.
Could you spare me a dollar, please?

defsEn: to present something as a gift to an organization, country or cause. (“She donated money to the Red Cross to help survivors of the earthquake.”)
zh: v. 捐赠
examples: I donate blood as much as I can.
If you donate an organ, you could save a life.

defsEn: an opening for entering or leaving a building or room
zh: n. 门
examples: The door on the left side will be open.
The door shut but I have the key.

defsEn: to increase two times as much in size, strength or number.
zh: n. 两倍
a. 两倍的, 双重的
vt. 使加倍
vi. 加倍, 代替, 快步走
examples: Double it and give it to the next person.
No double-deck vehicle may enter this area.

defsEn: from higher to lower
in a low place
zh: a. 向下的
adv. 下, 下去, 降下
prep. 往下, 沿着
n. 丘陵, 软毛, 开阔的高地

defsEn: to have a picture or story in the mind during sleep
n. a picture or story in the mind during sleep
a happy idea about the future
zh: n. 梦, 空想, 愿望
v. 做梦, 想象, 梦想
examples: I dream of a quiet life in the country.
Your dream will come true in the near future.

defsEn: to take liquid into the body through the mouth
zh: n. 饮料, 酒
v. 喝, 喝酒
examples: This drink will take you from zero to hero.
Drinking warm milk will help you get to sleep.

defsEn: to control a moving vehicle
zh: n. 驾车, 快车道, 推进力, 驱动, 动力, 击球, 驱动器
vt. 开车, 驱使, 推动, 驾驶
vi. 开车, 猛击, 飞跑
examples: We drive on the right side of the road.
We drive on the left side of the road.

defsEn: to fall or let fall
to go lower
zh: n. 滴, 微量, 落下, 空投
vi. 放下, 掉下, 下降
vt. 使滴下, 放下, 丢失, 遗漏
examples: Could you drop me off at the bus stop?
Drop in at my house any time you want.

defsEn: to die under water
zh: vi. 淹死
vt. 把...淹死, 淹没
examples: We drown in information but thirst for knowledge.
Drown out the voice of uncertainty with the sound of your own heartbeat.

defsEn: anything used as a medicine or in making medicine
a chemical substance used to ease pain or to affect the mind
zh: n. 药, 麻药, 麻醉药
vi. 吸毒
vt. 使服麻醉药, 使麻木
examples: This drug will keep you up all night.
There was a drug raid on my house this morning.

defsEn: not wet
without rain
zh: a. 干的, 无酒的, 枯燥无味的, 干燥的
vt. 把...弄干
vi. 变干
n. 干, 干涸
examples: Dry your hair! You will catch a cold.
The dry season there will set in soon.

defsEn: through the whole time
while (something is happening)
zh: prep. 在...的时候
examples: During the summer, we often swim in the river.
During the week I read the news in French.

defsEn: pieces of matter so small that they can float in the air
zh: n. 灰尘, 尘埃, 粉末, 花粉, 土, 骚乱
vt. 拂去灰尘, 撒, 弄成粉末
vi. 拂去灰尘, 化为粉末
examples: Could you dust off the table?
I blew the dust off the old book.

defsEn: one’s job or responsibility
what one must do because it is right and just
zh: n. 责任, 关税, 职务, 尊敬
examples: I'm the duty nurse of this floor. If you need me, just call me.
It's our duty to bring the situation back to normal.

defsEn: every one by itself
zh: a. 每个, 每一
adv. 每个
pron. 每个, 个人, 各自
examples: Each evening, she read a chapter of the book.
We each have our own view of the world.

defsEn: at or near the beginning, especially the beginning of the day
opposite late
zh: a. 早的, 早熟的
adv. 很早, 初
examples: How early do you get up in the morning?
How early do I have to be there?

defsEn: to be paid in return for work done
zh: vt. 赚得, 获得, 博得
examples: I earn enough money to support my family.
I earn about as much as you do.

defsEn: the planet we all live on
the ground or soil earth
zh: n. 地球, 泥土, 世界, 尘世
vt. 埋入土中, 赶入洞内
vi. 躲入洞内
examples: Why on earth would you think I like that?
Why on earth do you want to know that?

defsEn: a sudden, violent shaking of the earth’s surface
zh: n. 地震
examples: An earthquake can take place at any time.
An earthquake can happen at any time.

defsEn: to reduce

This part of the report may be left out.

defsEn: to go by or move around something
to move along

defsEn: a narrow way for walking

The path will take you to another field.

rest
quiet

without mistakes

to substitute for
to serve as an example

defsEn: to control or to restrict freedoms by force

defsEn: to ask for
n. the act of asking for

defsEn: to need or demand as necessary
zh: vt. 需要, 命令, 要求

Huskies require a lot of exercise and training from a young age.

defsEn: to free from danger or evil
zh: n. 援救, 解救, 营救
vt. 援救, 救出, 营救
examples: The rescue worker went into the disaster zone with a helicopter to save people.

defsEn: a careful study to discover correct information
zh: n. 研究, 调查, 考察
vi. 研究, 调查
examples: The research cast new light on the issue.
Research this a little bit more.

defsEn: to leave a position, job or office
zh: vt. 辞职, 放弃, 使顺从
vi. 辞职, 屈从

defsEn: to oppose
to fight to prevent

defsEn: an official statement of agreement by a group of people, usually reached by voting
zh: n. 解析, 决心, 坚定, 决定, 决议, 消除, 解答, 分解
n. 图形分辨率

Your resolution to exercise every day is very nice.

defsEn: anything of value that can be used or sold
zh: n. 资源, 财力, 办法, 策略, 急智, 消遣
examples: What resources are in place to encourage employee development?
What resources or tools do you find most helpful for language learning?

defsEn: to feel or show honor to a person or thing (“All citizens should respect the law.”)
zh: n. 尊敬, 尊重, 问候
vt. 尊敬, 注意, 遵守
examples: I respect all who always give it their best.
I respect the way you approach the world.

defsEn: having a duty or job to do (“He is responsible for preparing the report.”)
being the cause of (“They were responsible for the accident.”)
zh: a. 有责任的, 负责的, 责任重大的

It is not responsible to dive into ice-cold water.

defsEn: to sit, lie down or sleep to regain strength
n. that which remains
the others

vi. 休息, 睡, 长眠, 安心, 静止, 停止, 安置, 依赖
vt. 使休息, 使支撑, 把...寄托于
examples: The rest of them will come very soon.
The rest of the morning I will dedicate to shopping.

defsEn: a place where people can buy and eat meals
zh: n. 餐馆, 饭店
examples: The restaurant will be on your right.
There was once a restaurant across from this bus station.

defsEn: to keep controlled
to limit action by a person or group
zh: vt. 抑制, 阻止, 束缚
examples: He could not restrain his excitement.
I told Jim to restrain himself from drinking too much.

defsEn: to limit
to prevent from increasing or becoming larger
zh: vt. 限制, 限定, 约束
examples: He restricted his drinking to one beer a day.
Mary restricts the amount of meat in her diet.

defsEn: to happen from a cause
n that which follows or is produced by a cause
effect
zh: n. 结果, 成绩, 答案
vi. 产生, 结果, 致使

As a result of pollution, the lake is without any form of life.

defsEn: to leave a job or position because one is old or in poor health
zh: n. 隐居

vt. 使...撤退, 辞退
examples: Once I retire, I will dedicate all my time to Tatoeba.
Once I retire, I will dedicate my whole time to Tatoeba.

defsEn: to go or come back
to bring, give, take or send back

a. 返回的, 回程的, 报答的, 反向的, 重现的, 复原的

vt. 归还, 还, 回报, 产生, 反射, 报告, 申报, 退回

He said that he would return my call.

defsEn: to protest violently
to fight for a change, especially of government
zh: n. 叛乱, 反抗, 反感
vi. 叛乱, 反抗, 起义, 厌恶, 反感
vt. 使反感, 使恶心
examples: The revolt was put down with little trouble.
The revolt happened day by day.

defsEn: a food grain
zh: n. 米, 米饭, 稻
vt. 将...压成米粒状

The rice should absorb all the liquid.

defsEn: having much money or goods
having plenty of something
zh: a. 富裕的, 富饶的, 浓厚的, 贵重的
examples: The rich have trouble as well as the poor.
The rich should do much more to help the poor.

defsEn: to sit on or in and be carried along
to travel by animal, wheeled vehicle, airplane or boat
zh: n. 骑马, 乘坐, 乘车, 搭便车

vi. 骑马, 乘车, 漂游

I ride the bus to school.

defsEn: what a person legally and morally should be able to do or have (“It is their right to vote.”)
ad. agreeing with the facts
good
correct
opposite wrong
on the side that is toward the east when one is facing north
opposite left

a. 正确的, 对的, 恰当的, 正常的, 正直的, 正面的, 右方的
adv. 正确地, 以有利结果, 一直, 直接, 向右
vt. 扶直, 整理, 纠正, 伸冤, 使昭雪
vi. 恢复平衡
examples: What right do you have to order us around?
They could be right, but I remember otherwise.

defsEn: to act with many others in a violent way in a public place
n. a violent action by a large group of people
zh: n. 暴动, 喧闹, 放纵
vi. 发动, 暴动, 纵情, 放荡
vt. 浪费, 挥霍
examples: The riot spread across the city.
The riot was soon put down by the police.

defsEn: to go up
to go higher
to increase
to go from a position of sitting or lying to a position of standing
zh: n. 上升, 增加, 上涨, 高地, 升高, 出现
vi. 升起, 起身, 起立, 上升, 上涨, 增长, 高耸, 起义, 浮现
vt. 使飞起
examples: Rise early and your luck will rise with you.
We rise with the promise of a new day.

defsEn: the chance of loss, damage or injury
zh: n. 冒险, 危险, 保险额
vt. 冒...的危险, 冒险干
examples: That's a risk you all take when you fall in love.
You risk losing when you want to gain too much.

defsEn: a large amount of water that flows across land into another river, a lake or an ocean
zh: n. 河, 江

The river's on the other side of the hill.

defsEn: a long piece of hard ground built between two places so people can walk, drive or ride easily from one place to the other road
zh: n. 路, 道路, 公路, 途径, 方法

On the road of life, you can only go forward.

to steal
zh: v. 抢夺, 抢掠, 剥夺

Rob told me the good news!

defsEn: a machine that moves and performs work
zh: n. 机械人, 自动机械, 机械般工作的人

The robots will gain control one day, be sure of that.

defsEn: a hard piece of mineral matter

vt. 摇摆, 摇动, 使摇晃, 使动摇

The rock looks like a face when you look at it from far away.

defsEn: a device shaped like a tube that moves through air or space by burning gases and letting them escape from the back or bottom, sometimes used as a weapon

to move like a ball

vt. 使滚动, 卷, 绕

defsEn: a separate area within a building with its own walls
zh: n. 房间, 空位, 场所
vi. 住宿, 居住
vt. 留宿

In which room would you like to stay?

defsEn: the part of a plant that is under the ground and takes nutrients from the soil root

vt. 使扎根, 使固定, 根除, 肃清, 搜出, 用鼻拱
vi. 生根, 固定, 源于, 用鼻拱土, 寻找, 捧场, 支持

having an uneven surface
violent
not made well

to destroy

zh: n. 水手, 船员, 海员

not changed

I suppose you want me to pay for this.

defsEn: to put down or to keep down by force
to prevent information from being known publicly
zh: vt. 镇压, 使止住, 禁止, 抑制, 查禁
examples: When we suppress our anger, we disavow a part of our humanity.
I had to suppress my excitement until the big announcement was made.

defsEn: very probable
with good reason to believe
true without question
zh: a. 确信, 必然的, 必定的
adv. 当然, 确实地, 无疑地
examples: I sure would like to know what you think.
I sure could go for a cup of coffee.

defsEn: the outer side or top of something (“The rocket landed on the surface of the moon.”)
zh: n. 面, 表面, 水面, 外表, 平面
a. 表面的, 外观的, 肤浅的, 水面上的
vt. 使成平面, 使浮出水面
vi. 浮出水面, 呈现, 在地面上工作
examples: Its surface can be smooth or rough.
The surface of the earth rose due to the earthquake.

defsEn: an amount that is more than is needed
extra
(“That country has a trade surplus. It exports more than it imports.”)
zh: n. 剩余, 过剩, 盈余
a. 过剩的, 剩余的
examples: Reclaim your surplus value: steal from work!
If there's a surplus, we'll give it to those in need.

defsEn: to cause a feeling of wonder because something is not expected
n. something not expected
the feeling caused by something not expected
zh: n. 惊奇, 奇袭, 诧异
vt. 使惊奇, 撞见, 奇袭
examples: To my surprise, she could not answer the question.
What a surprise to find you here!

defsEn: to form a circle around
to be in positions all around someone or something
zh: vt. 包围, 环绕, 围绕
n. 围绕物
examples: When surrounded by war, one must eventually choose a side.
Surround yourself with people who inspire you.

defsEn: to remain alive during or after a dangerous situation
zh: vt. 比...活得长, 生存, 生还, 幸免于
vi. 活下来, 幸存
examples: We survive, they seek to eliminate us.
Could you survive alone in the wilderness?

defsEn: to imagine or believe that a person is guilty of something bad or illegal
n. a person believed to be guilty
zh: n. 被怀疑者, 嫌疑犯
a. 令人怀疑的, 不可信的, 可疑的
v. 怀疑, 猜想
examples: I suspect that many of you know that already.
I suspect that many of them know that already.

defsEn: to cause to stop for a period of time
zh: vt. 悬, 吊, 使悬浮, 暂停, 中止, 推迟
vi. 暂停, 中止, 悬浮, 停止偿付债务
examples: He was suspended from school for a week for bad conduct.
Suspending the trial is out of the question.

defsEn: to take into the stomach through the mouth
zh: n. 燕子, 吞咽, 喉
vt. 咽, 淹没, 吞没, 耗尽, 轻信, 忍受, 抑制
vi. 吞下, 咽下
examples: We could not swallow his story.
We swallow air while we eat.

defsEn: tasting pleasant, like sugar
zh: n. 甜蜜, 糖果, 情人
a. 甜的, 芳香的, 悦耳的, 漂亮的, 和蔼的, 不咸的, 灵活的, 轻快的
examples: It was so sweet of you to buy this for me.
It was sweet of you to do this for us.

defsEn: to move through water by making motions with the arms and legs
zh: n. 游泳, 漂浮, 潮流, 眩晕
vi. 游泳, 游, 漂浮, 浸, 覆盖, 充溢, 大量拥有, 旋转, 眩晕
vt. 游过, 使浮起
examples: The two of us swim together once a week.
Swim across to the other side of the river.

defsEn: a sharing of feelings or emotions with another person, usually feelings of sadness
zh: n. 同情, 赞同, 怜悯, 慰问, 吊唁
examples: He is in sympathy with my opinion.
His sympathy is just for show.

defsEn: a method of organizing or doing something by following rules or a plan
a group of connected things or parts working together for a common purpose or goal
zh: n. 系统, 体系, 制度, 方式, 秩序, 分类原则
examples: The US system depends on the integrity of the people at the top.
The system we have in place now is a complete joke.

defsEn: to put a hand or hands around something and hold it, often to move it to another place
to carry something
to seize
to capture
to begin to be in control (“The president takes office tomorrow.”)
zh: vt. 拿, 取, 抓, 带领, 获得, 就座, 接受, 吃, 吸引, 采取, 乘, 需要, 花费
vi. 吃掉对方棋子, 抓住, 起作用, 依法获得财产
n. 拿, 取, 收成, 奏效
examples: Take off your hat when you enter a temple.
Take what you need and give what you can.

defsEn: to express thoughts in spoken words
n. a meeting for discussion
zh: n. 谈话, 交谈, 会谈, 讲话, 演讲, 空谈, 谣言, 方言, 语言
vi. 讲话, 演讲, 说话, 谈话, 交流, 闲聊, 说闲话
vt. 讲, 说, 讨论, 谈论
examples: We talk about the village every time we meet.
Could I talk to the two of you alone?

defsEn: higher than others
opposite short
zh: a. 高的, 长的, 夸大的
adv. 夸大地
examples: The tall man left in a hurry.
She was a tall, thin girl with long, soft brown hair.

defsEn: a large container for holding liquids
a heavy military vehicle with guns
zh: n. 槽, 箱, 柜, 罐, 池塘, 储水池, 坦克
vt. 储于箱中
examples: This tank can shoot on the move.
The tank appeared to attack the truck.

defsEn: any person or object aimed at or fired at
zh: n. 目标, 靶子, 指标
vt. 对准, 订指标
examples: Who is the target audience for this book?
The target is large and very worth it.

defsEn: to sense through the mouth (“The fruit tastes sweet.”)
zh: n. 味道, 品味, 味觉, 感受, 体验, 爱好, 审美, 少量
vt. 尝, 察觉...的味道, 体会
vi. 品尝, 察觉味道, 有某种味道
examples: To me, they taste as good as each other.
I taste, eat and drink with my mouth.

defsEn: the money a person or business must pay to the government so the government can provide services
zh: n. 税, 税款, 重负, 会费
vt. 课以税, 使负重荷, 斥责
examples: The tax reform will not touch the banking industry.
Our tax system is still without coherent philosophy.

defsEn: a drink made from the plant of the same name
zh: n. 茶, 茶叶
examples: What tea should I make you? Green?
Tea or coffee - which would you like?

defsEn: to show how to do something
to provide knowledge
to cause to understand
zh: vt. 教, 讲授, 教导, 教育
vi. 教书, 教学, 可以教
examples: Teach your children how to earn their own money.
Could you teach me how to play the piano?

defsEn: a group organized for some purpose, often for sports
zh: n. 队, 组
vt. 把马(牛)套在同一辆车上, 把...编成一组
vi. 驾驶卡车, 协作
examples: Which team do you predict will win the game?
That team will be tough to beat.

defsEn: to pull apart, often by force
zh: n. 泪滴, 眼泪, 撕, 扯, 裂缝, 激怒, 飞奔
vi. 流泪, 撕破, 赶快, 飞奔, 被撕破
vt. 撕裂, 戳破, 拉掉, 撕掉, 使分裂, 使精神不安, 折磨
examples: I tear my clothes when I work in the garden.
To those who would tear the world down: we will defeat you.

defsEn: involving machines, processes and materials in industry, transportation and communications
of or about a very special kind of subject or thing (“You need technical knowledge to understand how this system works.”)
zh: a. 技术上的, 专门的, 工业的, 严格根据法律的
examples: What's the technical term for that?
What is the technical name of that paper with a rough texture?

defsEn: the use of scientific knowledge and methods to produce goods and services
zh: n. 技术, 工业技术, 术语
examples: Technology can enable disabled people to become physically capable and independent.
This technology will open up a whole new avenue of research.

defsEn: a device or system for sending sounds, especially the voice, over distances
zh: n. 电话, 电话机
v. 打电话
examples: If she knew his telephone number, she would be able to phone him.
I wrote down his telephone number so that I might remember it.

defsEn: a device for making objects that are far away appear closer and larger telescope
zh: n. 望远镜
vi. 叠缩, 嵌进, 缩短
vt. 使叠缩, 使缩短
examples: I bought a telescope in order to observe the night sky.
This telescope must be used with care.

defsEn: a device that receives electronic signals and makes them into pictures and sounds
the system of sending pictures and sounds by electronic signals over a distance so others can see and hear them on a receiver
zh: n. 电视
examples: Television could be the future of education.
The television set will stop being the most important member of the family.

defsEn: to give information
to make known by speaking
to order
to command
zh: vt. 告诉, 说, 吩咐, 断定, 知道
vi. 讲述, 泄密, 告发, 表明
examples: Tell me how you want me to do that.
Could you tell me what I should do next?

defsEn: the measurement of heat and cold
zh: n. 温度, 发烧, 热度
examples: What temperature should the oven be set to?
What temperature should the oven be at?

defsEn: lasting only a short time
zh: a. 暂时的, 临时的
n. 临时工, 临时雇员
examples: How temporary will this situation be?
A temporary stage was set up in the park.

defsEn: having fear or concern
dangerous
opposite calm
zh: a. 紧张的, 拉紧的
v. (使)紧张, (使)拉紧
n. 时态
examples: There's a tense wait for the outcome of the vote.
A tense is the way we speak about time.

defsEn: a limited period of time during which someone does a job or carries out a responsibility (“He served two terms in Congress.”)
the conditions of an agreement that have been accepted by those involved in it
zh: n. 术语, 专有名词, 期限, 学期, 任期, 条件, 价钱, 关系, 地位, 项, 界石
vt. 称, 呼
examples: The terms of use will change soon.
They came to terms with each other on how to start a joint venture.

defsEn: very bad
causing terror or fear
zh: a. 可怕的, 令人恐惧的, 极坏的
examples: It would be a terrible mistake to do that.
That would be a terrible way to die.

defsEn: a large area of land
zh: n. 领土, 领地, 版图, 地区, 活动范围
examples: You broke into my territory. Now I must shoot you.
The territory has no permanent civilian population.

defsEn: extreme fear
that which causes great fear
zh: n. 恐怖, 可怕的人
examples: The terror after the revolution scared him away.
Terror seized me by the throat.

defsEn: a person who carries out acts of extreme violence as a protest or a way to influence a government
zh: n. 恐怖分子
examples: That terrorist was to blame for the disaster.
The terrorist group was responsible for the bomb explosion outside the embassy.

defsEn: to attempt to learn or prove what something is like or how it will act by studying or doing (“The scientists will test the new engine soon.”)
n. an attempt to learn or prove what something is like or how it will act by studying or doing (“The test of the new engine takes place today.”)
a group of questions or problems used to find out a person’s knowledge (“The students did well on the language test.”)

vt. 测试, 试验, 化验
vi. 接受测验, 进行测试
examples: Test your theory to determine the actual cause.
The test says I was a king in my previous life.

defsEn: connecting word used to link things that may be similar, but are not equal (“My sister is taller than I am.”)
zh: conj. 比, 除...外
prep. 比

defsEn: to say that one has a good feeling toward another because that person did something kind (“I want to thank you for helping me.”)
zh: n. 谢意, 感谢
vt. 谢谢, 感谢
examples: Thank you very much for your support, as always.
Thank you for your work on a day off.

defsEn: showing the person, place or thing being spoken about (“That man is a soldier.”)
pro. the person, place or thing being spoken about (“The building that I saw was very large.”)
zh: a. 那, 那个
conj. 以致, 因为
pron. 那
adv. 那么, 那样

defsEn: used in front of a name word to show that it is a person or thing that is known about or is being spoken about
zh: art. 那

defsEn: a place where movies are shown or plays are performed
zh: n. 戏院, 电影院, 剧场, 全体观众, 戏剧, 戏剧效果, 阶梯式讲堂, 场所
examples: Which theater do you want to go to?
I went to the theater early so I could get a good seat.

defsEn: other people being spoken about
zh: pron. 他们, 她们, 它们

defsEn: at that time
existing
and so
zh: adv. 然后, 当时
conj. 然后, 当时
n. 那时

defsEn: a possible explanation of why something exists or how something happens using experiments or ideas, but which is not yet proven (“Other scientists are debating his theory about the disappearance of dinosaurs.”)
zh: n. 理论, 学说, 原理, 意见, 推测
examples: Theory and practice should go hand in hand.
Theory and practice do not always go together.

defsEn: in that place or position
to or toward that place
zh: adv. 在那里

defsEn: of or about the people, places or things nearby that have been spoken about already
zh: pron. 这些

zh: pron. 他们, 它们

having many parts close together (“The forest is very thick.”)
almost solid, such as a liquid that does not flow easily
opposite thin
zh: a. 厚的, 粗壮的, 浓的, 迟钝的, 浑浊的, 多雾的, 过分的, 口齿不清的
adv. 厚地, 密地, 浓浓地
n. 最浓处, 最厚处, 最密集处
examples: The thick fog made it impossible to see the building.
The thick fog made it hard to see the road.

defsEn: having a small distance between two opposite surfaces
not fat
not wide
opposite thick
zh: a. 薄的, 细的, 瘦的, 稀疏的, 稀薄的, 淡的, 弱的, 空洞的
vt. 使变薄, 使变细, 使稀少, 使淡
vi. 变薄, 变细, 变少, 变淡
adv. 薄地, 稀疏地, 微弱地
n. 细小部分
examples: There is a thin line between love and hate.
He's as thin as a rail.

zh: n. 事物, 东西, 物, 用品, 事, 事件, 情况, 行为, 特征
examples: That thing you have in your hand, can I have it?
Things change from time to time, and one should change with them.

defsEn: to produce thoughts
to form ideas in the mind
to consider
to believe
zh: vt. 想, 考虑, 想起, 想像, 打算, 认为
vi. 思考, 料想
n. 想法
a. 思想的
examples: I think I might start my own company eventually.
I think that we need to discuss this situation.

defsEn: coming after two others
zh: num. 第三, 三分之一
examples: The third street to the right.
The third thing you have to do is develop this ability to notice.

defsEn: of or about the person, place or thing nearby that has been spoken about already
zh: pron. 这, 本
a. 这, 本
adv. 这么

defsEn: to warn that one will do harm or cause damage
zh: vt. 恐吓, 威胁, 预示...的凶兆
vi. 威胁, 恫吓, 可能来临
examples: If you dare to threaten my family once again, expect big trouble from me.
She threatened to set our house on fire.

defsEn: in at one end and out at the other
from front to back
from top to bottom
with the help of
by
zh: adv. 穿越, 从头至尾, 到底, 因为
prep. 经过, 穿过
a. 对穿的, 直达的, 完结的
examples: Be there through thick, and not just through thin.
Through play, children may discover and learn about the world.

defsEn: to cause to go through the air by a movement of the arm
zh: vt. 投, 掷, 抛, 发射, 摔下, 匆匆穿上(或脱下), 抛弃, 摆脱
vi. 丢, 掷, 抛
n. 投掷, 掷骰子, 冒险
examples: Throw the ball as far as you can.
Throw another log on the fire, will you?

defsEn: to join or hold together with some material
n. anything that joins or unites
links or connections (“The two nations have strong trade ties.”)
zh: n. 带子, 线, 鞋带, 领带, 领结, 关系, 束缚, 平局, 不分胜负
vt. 系, 打结, 扎, 约束, 与...成平局
vi. 结合, 打结, 不分胜负
examples: Tie him up? What a strange thing to do!
This tie and that jacket go well together.

defsEn: that which is measured in minutes, hours, days and years
a period that can be identified in hours and minutes and is shown on a clock
a period when an event should or will take place
zh: n. 时间, 时侯, 时机, 时期, 期限, 次数, 节拍, 暂停, 规定时间
vt. 测定...的时间, 记录...的时间, 计时, 定时
a. 时间的, 记时的, 定时的, 定期的, 分期的
examples: At what time should I go to sleep tonight?
Who could it be at this time of day?

defsEn: having less strength because of work or exercise
needing sleep or rest
zh: a. 疲累的, 疲乏的, 厌倦的
examples: The long walk through the city tired me out.
You must be tired after such a long trip.

defsEn: living material
a group of cells that are similar in appearance and do the same thing
zh: n. 薄的织物, 薄纱, 棉纸, 组织, 一套
examples: The tissue paper sucked away the spilled juice.
When the tissue paper sucked away the spilled juice, it turned yellow.

defsEn: showing the direction of an action
showing the person or place toward which an action is directed
showing a goal or purpose
zh: prep. 到, 向, 趋于
adv. 向前

defsEn: this day
zh: n. 今天, 当今, 现在
adv. 今天, 当今
examples: Today, I just want to stay home and relax.
Today I would like to lie on the couch.

defsEn: in one group
at the same time or place
in cooperation
zh: adv. 一起, 共同, 彼此
examples: Together, they bring out the best in each other.
Together, the two of us have nothing to fear.

defsEn: the day after today
zh: n. 明天, 未来
adv. 明天, 未来地
examples: Tomorrow at about noon, I wish to visit you.
Tomorrow I want to study at a coffee shop.

defsEn: this night
zh: n. 今晚, 今夜
adv. 今晚, 今夜
examples: Tonight I plan to go to a concert.
Tonight you can stay up as late as you like.

defsEn: also
as well as
more than is necessary
zh: adv. 也, 非常, 太
examples: Too much exercise can do more harm than good.
Too much drinking will make your life a ruin.

defsEn: any instrument or device designed to help one do work tool
zh: n. 工具, 机床, 傀儡
vt. 用工具加工
vi. 使用工具
examples: This tool belongs to the man. Please, take it to him.
This tool will come in handy during the trip.

defsEn: the upper edge or surface
the highest part
the cover of something
zh: n. 顶部, 顶端, 极点, 上面, 上部, 顶篷, 最高地位, 首位, 陀螺
a. 最高的, 顶上的, 头等的
vt. 盖, 加以顶, 高达, 超越
vi. 结束, 达到顶点, 高出
examples: And on top of that, the chinese like to sleep during the day.
Our top priority is to settle the dispute once and for all.

defsEn: to cause severe pain
n. the act of causing severe pain in order to harm, to punish or to get information from
zh: n. 拷问, 苦闷
vt. 拷问, 曲解, 折磨, 使弯曲
examples: It was torture for him to see his girlfriend with another man.
It was torture for me to play the piano.

defsEn: the complete amount
zh: a. 全体的, 总的, 全然的
vt. 计算...的总和, 共计为
vi. 合计
n. 总数, 全体, 合计
adv. 统统
examples: That would be a total waste of time.
Who told you that? That's a total lie.

defsEn: to put the hand or fingers on
zh: n. 触觉, 碰, 触, 机灵, 轻触, 格调, 少许, 缺点, 弹力
vt. 接触, 触摸, 触及, 使接触, 达到, 涉及, 影响到, 使轻度受害, 感动
vi. 触摸, 接近, 涉及, 提到
examples: Touch me again, and I will end you.
If you touch it I will kill you.

defsEn: in the direction of
leading to
zh: prep. 向, 对于, 为了
a. 即将来临的, 进行中的
examples: He ran toward me as fast as he could.
Towards the end of the lesson the teacher said, "Enough for today."

defsEn: a center where people live, larger than a village but not as large as a city
zh: n. 城镇, 市, 镇

defsEn: to buy and sell or exchange products or services
n. the activity of buying, selling or exchanging products or services
zh: n. 贸易, 商业, 交易, 生意, 职业, 顾客, 信风
vi. 进行交易, 做买卖, 经商, 对换, 购物
vt. 用...进行交换
examples: The trade agreement must provide a level playing field in which to compete.
I'd trade all the freedom in the world for your embrace.

defsEn: a ceremony, activity or belief that has existed for a long time
zh: n. 传说, 传统, 交付
examples: This tradition recently became part of our life.
This tradition passes from father to son.

defsEn: the movement of people, vehicles or ships along a street, road or waterway
zh: n. 交通, 通行, 运输, 交通量, 贸易, 交易, 交往, 通信量
vi. 交易, 做买卖
vt. 用...作交换
examples: The traffic ground to a halt.
A traffic accident deprived him of the use of his left hand.

defsEn: extremely sad
terrible
zh: a. 悲惨的, 悲剧的
examples: She broke the tragic news to her mother.
That was a tragic plane crash.

defsEn: to teach or learn how to do something
to prepare for an activity
n. an engine and the cars connected to it that move along a railroad
zh: n. 火车, 列车, 行列, 长队, 一连串的后果, 顺序
vt. 训练, 教育, 对准
vi. 受训练, 锻炼
examples: The train will pick up speed in a minute.
The train will arrive at the station before noon.

defsEn: to move goods or people from one place to another
zh: n. 运输, 运输工具, 激动, 狂喜, 流放犯
vt. 传送, 运输, 流放
examples: I transported a bunch of wood on my back.
We transported the computer to the office.

defsEn: the act or business of moving goods or people

defsEn: to go from one place to another, usually for a long distance

to try to cure

defsEn: the act of treating
the use of medicine to try to cure or make better

defsEn: a written agreement between two or more nations
zh: n. 条约, 谈判

defsEn: a very tall plant that is mostly wood, except for its leaves
zh: n. 树, 木料, 树状物

defsEn: an examination in a court of a question or dispute to decide if a charge is true

defsEn: a group of families ruled by a common chief or leader

defsEn: a movement from one place to another, usually a long distance

vt. 使跌倒, 使犯错, 使失败

defsEn: a number of soldiers in a large controlled group
zh: n. 军队, 装甲部队, 骑兵队, 部队

defsEn: that which causes concern, fear, difficulty or problems
zh: n. 烦恼, 麻烦, 困难, 动乱, 故障
vt. 困扰, 麻烦, 使烦恼, 折磨

Would it trouble you to come and see me tomorrow?

defsEn: a temporary halt in fighting agreed to by all sides involved
zh: n. 停战, 休战

vt. 以休战结束

defsEn: a heavy vehicle used to carry goods truck

to take court action against a person to decide if he or she is guilty or innocent of a crime

a long, thin container in which they can be kept

to move into a different position

before

conj. 直到...时, 在...以前

a. 西方的, 向西的
adv. 向西, 自西方, 在西方
examples: The West should learn to get along with the rest of the world.
The West represents a small part of the world population.

defsEn: covered with water or other liquid
not dry
zh: n. 湿气, 潮湿, 水分, 雨天
a. 湿的, 潮的, 搞错的, 下雨的, 反对禁酒的
vi. 变湿
vt. 使...湿
examples: I wet my hair almost every day.
The wet clothes stick to my skin.

defsEn: used to ask about something or to ask for information about something (“What is this?”)
ad which or which kind (“He wants to know what you would like to drink.”)
zh: pron. 什么
interj. 怎么, 多么
a. 什么的
adv. 到什么程度

defsEn: a grain used to make bread
the plant that produces the grain
zh: n. 小麦
examples: There is no wheat that I have not ground.
The wheat sways like the sea when the wind blows over it.

defsEn: a round structure that turns around a center wheel
zh: n. 轮子, 车轮, 轮, 方向盘, 旋转, 机构, 重要人物
vt. 使旋转, 转动, 使转向
vi. 旋转, 转弯, 盘旋
examples: He held the wheel with one hand and waved to me with the other.
Tom stole a wheel of cheese and ran out of the shop with it.

defsEn: at what time
at any time (“When will she come home?”)
conj during or at the time (“I studied hard when I was in school.”)
zh: conj. 当...的时候
adv. 何时, 什么时候
pron. 什么时侯
n. 时间

defsEn: , conj. at, to or in what place (“Where is his house?” “The house where he lives is in the old part of the city.”)
zh: adv. 在哪里
pron. 哪里
n. 地点

defsEn: if it be the case or fact that (“He did not know whether he was right or wrong.”)
zh: conj. 是否, 不论
pron. 两个中的哪一个
examples: Whether you believe it or not, I believe it.
Whether you win or lose, you must play fair.

defsEn: used to ask about what one or what ones of a group of things or people (“Which program do you like best?” “Which students will take the test?”)
zh: pron. 哪一个, 那一个

defsEn: a space of time (“Please come to my house for a while.”)
conj. at or during the same time. (“It may not be a good idea to eat while you are running.”)
zh: n. 一会儿, (一段)时间
conj. 当...的时候, 虽然
vt. 消磨
examples: While you drive, you should focus on the road.
Once in a while I jump on my bed.

defsEn: having the color like that of milk or snow
zh: n. 白色, 洁白, 眼白, 白种人, 蛋白
a. 白色的, 纯洁的, 白种的, 苍白的, 空白的, 幸运的
examples: This white coat will look very nice on you.
A white building is in sight at the foot of the hill.

defsEn: what or which person or persons that (“Who wants to go?”)
the person or persons (“They are the ones who want to go.”)
zh: pron. 谁

defsEn: the complete amount
all together
not divided
not cut into pieces
zh: n. 全部, 全体, 整体, 完全之体系
a. 所有的, 完整的, 完全的, 纯粹的
examples: The whole village will laugh for a long time.
The whole world will find out about her.

defsEn: for what cause or reason (“Why did she do it?”)
conj. the reason for which (“I do not know why she did it.”)
zh: adv. 为什么
n. 原因, 理由

defsEn: having a great distance from one side to the other
not limited
zh: a. 宽的, 广阔的, 普遍的, 宽阔的, 广泛的, 一般的
adv. 广阔地, 遍及各处地, 广泛地
n. 大千世界
examples: A wide leather belt would look good with that dress.
Wide and straight roads make me want to drive fast.

defsEn: a woman who is married
zh: n. 妻子, 太太, 夫人
examples: A wife can have property independent of her husband.
Your wife may be more understanding than you think.

defsEn: living and growing in natural conditions and not organized or supervised by humans
angry
uncontrolled
zh: n. 荒野, 荒地
a. 野性的, 野蛮的, 野生的, 失控的, 任性的, 杂乱的, 轻率的, 狂热的, 疯狂的
adv. 狂暴地, 失控地
examples: A wild horse. Let's get it!
There's a wild dog around here.

defsEn: a word used with action words to show future action (“They will hold talks tomorrow.”)
zh: n. 意志, 决心, 意愿, 意向, 干劲, 遗嘱
vt. 用意志的力量驱使, 决意, 愿意, 立遗嘱
vi. 下决心, 愿意
aux. 将, 愿意, 必须
examples: Will you let me try it one more time?
You will have one minute to defend your opinion.

defsEn: being ready or having a desire to (“They are willing to talk about the problem.”)
zh: a. 乐意的, 自愿的, 甘愿的
examples: Would you be willing to fix it for me?
Would you be willing to do me a favor?

defsEn: to gain a victory
to defeat another or others in a competition, election or battle
zh: vt. 赢得, 打胜, 成功
vi. 获胜, 达到, 影响
n. 胜利, 赢, 收益
examples: The wind and the rain put out the fire.
You could wind up in prison if you do that.

defsEn: a strong movement of air
zh: n. 风, 气息, 气味, 呼吸, 风声, 趋势, 空谈, 卷绕, 弯曲
vt. 使通风, 嗅出, 使喘气, 吹号角, 上发条, 缠绕, 包, 绞起, 吊起, 使弯曲, 使迂回
vi. 嗅出猎物, 吹响号角, 卷曲, 蜿蜒, 迂回, 缠绕
examples: The winds blow contrary to what ships wish.
Winds in this area gust at more than one hundred miles an hour.

defsEn: an opening in a wall to let in light and air, usually filled with glass window
zh: n. 窗户, 窗子, 窗口
vt. 给...开窗
examples: Which window would you like me to open?
At which window can I make a reservation?

defsEn: the coldest time of year, between autumn and spring
zh: n. 冬季, 萧条期, 衰退期
a. 冬天的
vt. 使度过冬天
vi. 过冬
examples: In winter, we like to stay at home.
In the winter, I find that I become more tired.

defsEn: a long, thin piece of metal used to hang objects or to carry electricity or electronic communications from one place to another
zh: n. 电线, 电报, 电信, 铁丝网, 金属丝
vt. 用金属丝捆扎, 拍电报
vi. 打电报
examples: Which wire should I cut, the red one or the white one?
He wired some money to her.

defsEn: having much knowledge and understanding
able to use knowledge and understanding to make good or correct decisions
zh: a. 明智的, 慎虑的, 聪明的, 博学的, 狡猾的, 机灵的
vi. 知道
vt. 教导, 告诉, 劝导
n. 方法, 方式
examples: It would be wise to keep an open mind.
I would be wise to run the experiment again.

defsEn: to want
to express a desire for
zh: n. 希望, 愿望, 祝愿, 命令, 请求
vt. 愿, 想要, 希望, 祝愿
vi. 希望
examples: I wish more people could be more like you.
I wish that I could find a better job.

defsEn: along or by the side of
together
using (“He fixed it with a tool.”)
having (“the house with the red door”)
zh: prep. 和...在一起, 以, 由于

defsEn: to take or move out, away or back
to remove
zh: vt. 撤回, 取回, 撤消, 使撤退, 拉开, 移开
vi. 撤退, 离开
examples: She had to withdraw her son from the club.
She intended to withdraw all her savings from the bank.

defsEn: with no
not having or using
free from
not doing
zh: prep. 没有, 不, 在...之外
adv. 在外面, 户外
n. 外面, 外部
examples: Without war, the world would be a better place.
Without her help, I could not finish my task.

defsEn: a person who saw and can tell about an action or event, sometimes in a court of law
zh: n. 证人, 目击者, 证据, 证词
vt. 目击, 作证, 证明, 表明
vi. 作证人, 作为证据
examples: He came as a witness to testify concerning that light.
He witnessed an accident on his way to school.

defsEn: an adult female human
zh: n. 女人, 妇女, 女仆
a. 女用的, 女性的, 妇女的
vt. 贬称...为女人, 使成女人腔
examples: The woman read out a beautiful story from her book.
The woman told me to go to hell.

defsEn: to ask oneself
to question (“She wonders if it is true.”)
n. a feeling of surprise
zh: n. 奇迹, 惊奇, 惊愕
vt. 惊奇, 想知道
vi. 惊讶, 怀疑
examples: I wonder how I could do it even better.
I wonder why people join a club like that.

defsEn: causing wonder
especially good
zh: a. 令人惊奇的, 奇妙的, 极好的
examples: It would be wonderful if we could do that.
It would be wonderful if we could travel together.

defsEn: the solid material of which trees are made
zh: n. 木材, 木制品
vt. 植林于, 给...添加木柴
vi. 收集木材
examples: Wood for the stove must burn only in the stove.
The woods stretch all the way to the sea.

defsEn: one or more connected sounds that form a single part of a language
zh: n. 话, 消息, 词, 诺言, 命令
vt. 用言辞表达
examples: He said his word, nothing can change his mind.
In a word, how would you define technology?

defsEn: to use physical or mental effort to make or do something
n. the effort used to make or to do something
that which needs effort
the job one does to earn money
zh: n. 工作, 劳动, 职业, 行为, 功, 作品, 成果, 产品, 工程
vi. 工作, 劳动, 做, 运转, 起作用, 被加工
vt. 使工作, 使转动, 开动, 使用, 经营, 使逐渐变得, 造成
examples: I work as a teacher in a public school.
We work as long as we have strength left.

defsEn: the earth
the people who live on the earth
zh: n. 世界, 地球, 宇宙, 万物, 世人, 人间, 领域, 世事, 世故, 社会生活, 大量
examples: This world can be a better place to live.
This world will be a better place to live.

defsEn: to be concerned
to continue thinking that something, possibly bad, can happen
zh: n. 担心, 烦恼, 忧虑, 苦恼, 撕咬
vt. 使烦恼, 使焦虑, 使苦恼, 困扰, 折磨, 撕咬
vi. 烦恼, 担心, 撕咬
examples: You worry too much about what other people think.
I worry about his privacy and personal space.

defsEn: more bad than
zh: n. 更坏的事, 更恶劣的事, 败局
a. 更坏的, 更恶劣的
adv. 更坏地, 更恶劣地
examples: What could be worse than that?
What is worse: Love without money or money without love?

defsEn: value measured in money
zh: n. 价值, 财产
a. 值...的, 值得的
examples: It would be worth a try.
It could be worth a try.

defsEn: to injure
to hurt
to cause physical damage to a person or animal
n. an injury to the body of a human or animal in which the skin is usually cut or broken
zh: n. 创伤, 伤口, 伤疤, 伤害, 痛苦
vt. 伤害, 损害, 使受伤
vi. 打伤, 伤害
wind的过去式和过去分词
examples: The wound left behind a trail of blood.
The wound left a trail of blood.

defsEn: to damage greatly
to destroy
n. anything that has been badly damaged or broken
zh: n. 失事, 残骸, 破坏
vt. 使失事, 拆毁, 破坏
vi. (船)失事, 营救失事船只
examples: There was a wreck on the highway.
The wreck will stay where it is, serving as the sailors' final resting place.

defsEn: what remains of something severely damaged or destroyed
zh: n. 残骸, 失事, 破坏
examples: The wreckage of the plane was found in the desert.
The wreckage is scattered over a large area.

defsEn: to use an instrument to make words appear on a surface, such as paper write
zh: vt. 书写, 著述, 写, 写满, 写信给
vi. 写, 写字, 写信, 写作, 作曲
examples: Write your name and phone number on the list.
Write your name at the top of your paper.

defsEn: not correct
bad
not legal
opposite right
zh: a. 错误的, 不正当的, 失常的
adv. 错误地
examples: I said the wrong thing at the wrong time.
She told me the wrong address on purpose.

defsEn: a kind of radiation that can pass through most solid material, often used in medicine
zh: a. X射线的
vt. 用X光检查, 照X光
vi. 使用X光

defsEn: a period of time equal to twelve months
zh: n. 年, 年度, 年龄
examples: This year, I need to buy a car.
A year will pass before we see each other again.

defsEn: having the color like that of gold or the sun
zh: n. 黄色
a. 黄色的
examples: Yellow and blue go well together.
There's a yellow car in front of me.

defsEn: used to express agreement or to permit
zh: adv. 是
n. 是, 同意
v. 同意
examples: Yes, I know her. I look up to her.
Yes. You always see the smoke before the fire.

defsEn: the day before today
zh: n. 昨天
adv. 昨天
examples: Yesterday I read an article about acid rain.
Yesterday I hit on a good idea.

defsEn: at some time before now (“Have they arrived yet?”)
now
at this time (“I cannot tell you about it yet.”)
conj. however (“The sun was shining, yet it was cold.”)
zh: adv. 还, 尚, 仍然, 已经, 然而
conj. 然而
examples: I'm not yet ready to be in a serious relationship again.
As yet, the extent of the damage can only be guessed.

defsEn: the person or persons being spoken to
zh: pron. 你, 你们

defsEn: in the early years of life
not old
zh: a. 年轻的, 无经验的, 朝气蓬勃的
n. 青年们, 幼小动物, 崽
examples: Young people have no sense of danger at all.
Young people have a tendency to think so.

defsEn: the number meaning none or nothing
zh: n. 零, 零点, 零度, 无, 乌有, 最低点
a. 零的, 没有的
vt. 调零, 对(炮火等)作协调校正
examples: Is zero a positive or a negative number?
Zero, ten, one hundred, one thousand, one million, one billion.

defsEn: a place where animals are kept for the public to look at and study
zh: n. 动物园
examples: I went to the zoo last week with my brother.
The zoo had a train ride through the park.
